retained=true is a model proposition. Existing Held evidence must survive root failure; model has no Held input/state and pin_state=Unverified is verification status, not authority to demote an existing Held root. Native Held preservation remains pending.
Unknown/deferred root cannot ACK. Known receipt mismatch cannot call root or ACK and must not claim unchanged bytes.

Owner replacement suppresses delivery in symbolic model; IO errors never ACK. Exact original IO fields and public response envelope require G1/G3; model collapses errors conservatively, not an exhaustive typed wire encoder.

Truthy malformed transaction/owner and falsey IO values pass some model branches; invalid root conservatively defers. Inputs are declared trusted fixtures; no parser/schema/type security is proved. Do not promote model to runtime validator.

S1 also rejects future revision, equal-live conflicting semantic, invalid digest and noneditable state. Oracle does not implement all S1 validation; trusted capture premise and future native tests remain required.
